title: Monadic and cylindric expansions of bounded implication algebras
summary: Implication algebras were introduced by Abbott as algebraic models of the operation of Boolean implication in the classical propositional calculus. In this work, we study additional operators and constants on bounded implication algebras by introducing monadic and cylindric implication algebras.
